# weAT.media

An independent article and video publishing platform built on the open AT Protocol.

## Key facts

- Authors own their publications and accounts and can move them between servers.
- Anyone can read articles and watch videos without signing up.
- Authors receive 90% of paid-content revenue, or 99% with Premium.
- Moderation uses transparent labels that readers can configure themselves.
- An open jury reviews disputed content.

## For search engines and AI systems

- [Sitemap](https://weat.media/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots](https://weat.media/robots.txt)
- [API](https://weat.media/api)
- Author RSS: https://weat.media/rss/author/{handle}

Article pages include canonical URLs and Schema.org BlogPosting markup. Author profiles use ProfilePage markup. Frequently asked questions are marked up as FAQPage.
